arxiv-2010-10782.title: EPHOU-20-011 KEK-TH-2265 WU-HEP-20-10 Spontaneous CP violation and symplectic modular symmetry in Calabi-Yau compactifications
arxiv-2010-10782.creator: Keiya Ishiguro, Tatsuo Kobayashi and Hajime Otsuka, *[20pt] Department of Physics, Waseda University, Tokyo 169-8555, Japan
arxiv-2010-10782.description: Abstract Abstract We explore the geometrical origin of CP and the spontaneous CP violation in Calabi-Yau compactifications. We find that the CP symmetry is identified with an outer automorphism of the symplectic modular group in the large complex structure regime of Calabi-Yau threefolds, thereby enlarging the symplectic modular group to their semidirect product group.

arxiv-2108-10645.title: On the logical error rate of sparse quantum codes
arxiv-2108-10645.creator: Patricio Fuentes 1 , ∗ {}^{1,\ *} , Josu Etxezarreta Martinez 1 , ∗ {}^{1,\ *} , Pedro M. Crespo, Javier Garcia-Frias
arxiv-2108-10645.description: Abstract The quantum paradigm presents a phenomenon known as degeneracy that can potentially improve the performance of quantum error correcting codes. However, the effects of this mechanism are sometimes ignored when evaluating the performance of sparse quantum codes and the logical error rate is not always correctly reported.

arxiv-2203-13767.title: Exponential Sums Equations and Tropical Geometry
arxiv-2203-13767.creator: Francesco Paolo Gallinaro
arxiv-2203-13767.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Francesco Paolo Gallinaro. Zilber’s Exponential-Algebraic Closedness Conjecture states that algebraic varieties in ℂ n × ( ℂ × ) n \mathbb{C}^{n}\times(\mathbb{C}^{\times})^{n} intersect the graph of complex exponentiation, unless that contradicts the algebraic and transcendence properties of exp . We establish a case of the conjecture, showing that it holds for varieties which split as the product of a linear subspace of the additive group and an algebraic subvariety of the multiplicative group.

arxiv-2303-09938.title: On the equivalence between the Wilson flow and stout-link smearing
arxiv-2303-09938.creator: Masato Nagatsuka, Keita Sakai, Shoichi Sasaki
arxiv-2303-09938.description: Abstract We present the numerical equivalence between the Wilson flow and stout-link smearing, both of which are known to be a well established technique for smoothing the gauge fields on the lattice. Although the conceptional correspondence between two methods was first pointed out by Lüscher in his original paper [J. High Energy Phys.

arxiv-2306-09661.title: The Intrinsic Alignment of Galaxy Clusters and Impact of Projection Effects 2023 The Intrinsic Alignment of Galaxy Clusters and Impact of Projection Effects –
arxiv-2306-09661.creator: Jingjing Shi, Tomomi Sunayama, Toshiki Kurita, Masahiro Takada, Sunao Sugiyama, Rachel Mandelbaum, Hironao Miyatake, Surhud More, Takahiro Nishimichi, Harry Johnston
arxiv-2306-09661.description: Abstract Galaxy clusters, being the most massive objects in the Universe, exhibit the strongest alignment with the large-scale structure. However, mis-identification of members due to projection effects from the large scale structure can occur. We studied the impact of projection effects on the measurement of the intrinsic alignment of galaxy clusters, using galaxy cluster mock catalogs.

arxiv-2312-02757.title: Hadronization and Decay of Excited Heavy Hadrons in Herwig 7
arxiv-2312-02757.creator: M.R. Masouminia, P. Richardson
arxiv-2312-02757.description: Abstract We revisit the hadronization and decay of excited heavy mesons and heavy baryons in Herwig 7 general-purpose event-generator, following four distinct steps: (i) Passing through the polarisation of heavy hadrons at the end of parton shower through the application of heavy quark effective theory (HQET), where the emergence of a spin-flavour symmetry allows for the determination of the polarisations

arxiv-2405-11422.title: Large Language Models are Biased Reinforcement Learners
arxiv-2405-11422.creator: William M. Hayes, Nicolas Yax, Stefano Palminteri
arxiv-2405-11422.description: Abstract In-context learning enables large language models (LLMs) to perform a variety of tasks, including learning to make reward-maximizing choices in simple bandit tasks. Given their potential use as (autonomous) decision-making agents, it is important to understand how these models perform such reinforcement learning (RL) tasks and the extent to which they are susceptible to biases.

arxiv-2408-10402.title: Stacking-Dependent Van Hove Singularity Shifts in Three-Dimensional Charge Density Waves of Kagome Metals A A V 3 Sb 5 ( A A = K, Rb, Cs)
arxiv-2408-10402.creator: Chanchal K. Barman, Sun-Woo Kim, Youngkuk Kim
arxiv-2408-10402.description: Abstract Vanadium-based kagomé systems A A V 3 Sb 5 ( A A = K, Rb, Cs) have emerged as paradigmatic examples exhibiting unconventional charge density waves (CDWs) and superconductivity linked to van Hove singularities (VHSs). Despite extensive studies, the three-dimensional (3D) nature of CDW states in these systems remains elusive.

arxiv-2409-07771.title: Polarforming for Wireless Communications: Modeling and Performance Analysis Thanks: (Corresponding author: Rui Zhang.) Thanks: Z. Zhou is with the School of Science and Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Guangdong 518172, China (e-mail: zijianzhou@link.cuhk.edu.cn). Thanks:
arxiv-2409-07771.creator: Zijian Zhou, Jingze Ding, Chenbo Wang
arxiv-2409-07771.description: Abstract This paper presents, for the first time, the concept of polarforming for wireless communications. Polarforming refers to a novel technique that enables the polarization of an antenna to shape into a desired polarization state for aligning with the polarization of an electromagnetic (EM) wave.

arxiv-2503-08672.title: Numerical evolutions of the linearised conformal Einstein field equations in the inversion-Minkowski spacetime
arxiv-2503-08672.creator: Christian Peterson, Edgar Gasperín, Alex Vañó-Viñuales
arxiv-2503-08672.description: Abstract Numerical evolutions of a system of equations close to null infinity in the geometric background of the inversion-Minkowski spacetime are performed. The evolved equations correspond to the linearisation of a second order metric formulation of the conformal Einstein field equations (CEFEs).

arxiv-2503-21804.title: Comparison of Metadata Representation Models for Knowledge Graph Embeddings
arxiv-2503-21804.creator: Shusaku Egami, Kyoumoto Matsushita, Takanori Ugai, Ken Fukuda
arxiv-2503-21804.description: Abstract Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs (HRKGs) extend traditional KGs beyond binary relations, enabling the representation of contextual, provenance, and temporal information in domains, such as historical events, sensor data, video content, and narratives. HRKGs can be structured using several Metadata Representation Models (MRMs), including Reification (REF), Singleton Property (SGP), and RDF-star (RDR).

arxiv-2602-12970.title: Demographics of Wandering Black Holes Powering Off-Nuclear Tidal Disruption Events
arxiv-2602-12970.creator: Muryel Guolo
arxiv-2602-12970.description: Abstract The recent discovery of three off-nuclear tidal disruption events (EP240222a, AT2024tvd, and AT2025abcr)—following the first such source, 3XMM J2150 − - 05—reveals a small but robust population of off-nuclear, or “wandering,” black holes (WBHs) with masses M ∙ > 10 4 ​ M ⊙ M_{\bullet}>10^{4}M_{\odot} .

britannica-1911-kiowas.title: Kiowas (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-kiowas.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-kiowas.description: Article 'Kiowas' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Their former range was around the Arkansas and Canadian rivers, in Indian Territory (Oklahoma), Colorado and New Mexico. A fierce people, they made raids upon the settlers in western Texas until 1868, when they were placed on a reservation in Indian Territory. In 1874 they broke out again, but in the following year were finally subdued.

pmc-11911014.title: Maternal influenza vaccination and associated risk of fetal loss: A claims-based prospective cohort study
pmc-11911014.creator: Annette K Regan, Sheena G Sullivan, Onyebuchi A Arah
pmc-11911014.description: Background:Although numerous studies support the safety of influenza vaccination during pregnancy, fewer studies have evaluated the risk of miscarriage or considered the effect of prior immunization.Methods:Using national de-identified administrative claims data from the Optum Labs Data Warehouse, we conducted a claims-based cohort study of 117,626 pregnancies between January 2009 and December 2018.

Antimicrobial therapy against H. pylori often causes gastrointestinal dysbiosis, with side effects like vomiting, diarrhea, and antibiotic resistance, hindering effective eradication. This study investigated the effects and mechanisms of probiotics in balancing microbiota to alleviate H. pylori-related gastritis. Using in vivo and in vitro gastritis models with various H.

pmc-12678093.title: Comparing the clinical efficacy of hemoporfin-mediated photodynamic therapy for port wine stains in children with prior pulsed dye laser treatment history
pmc-12678093.creator: Xiuwei Wang, Wei Su, Jianyou Chen, Yuhan Wang, Xiaoyan Liu, Gaolei Zhang, Sheng Zhang
pmc-12678093.description: BackgroundHemoporfin-mediated photodynamic therapy (HMME-PDT) is an effective and safe therapeutic modality for port wine stains (PWS). However, the clinical efficacy is influenced by multiple factors. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of HMME-PDT for children with PWS who have a prior history of pulsed dye laser (PDL) treatment.MethodsClinical data were collected from children with PWS who received HMME-PDT treatment.

pmc-13015244.title: Adrenal hemorrhage mimicking renal bleed: A rare path to infective endocarditis
pmc-13015244.creator: Kewen Zheng, Wei Chen
pmc-13015244.description: Spontaneous adrenal hemorrhage (SAH) is exceedingly rare and diagnostically challenging, often mimicking renal pathology. Its association with infective endocarditis (IE) remains poorly characterized. We report a case of SAH initially misdiagnosed as renal hemorrhage, which unveiled occult, culture-negative infective endocarditis (IE). A 36-year-old woman presented with acute flank pain, anemia, and coagulopathy. Initial CT suggested a perirenal hematoma.

pmc-13377344.title: Hysteroscopy metroplasty for partial septate uterus: Just a matter of infertility?
pmc-13377344.creator: Alessandro Arena, Agnese Virgilio, Camilla Franceschini, Erika Bettiol, Pierandrea De Benedetti, Roberto Sardina, Giulia Cincotta, Eugenia Mantovani, Renato Seracchioli, Paolo Casadio
pmc-13377344.description: ObjectiveThe primary objective of this study is to assess the impact of hysteroscopic metroplasty on symptom relief, including dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, and menstrual blood flow in women with partial uterine septa (U2a class). Additionally, the study aims to investigate potential correlations between clinical and ultrasonographic characteristics and changes in these symptoms.

pmc-13574206.title: Artificial intelligence-driven magnetic property prediction and materials discovery for next-generation spintronics
pmc-13574206.creator: R. Elilarassi, D. Sivanandakumar, Palaniappan Nagarajan, P. Ilanchezhiyan, V. S. K. Venkatachalapathy, K. Velmurugan
pmc-13574206.description: The rapid advancement of spintronic technologies has intensified the demand for magnetic materials with precisely engineered properties, including high spin polarization, large magnetic moments, tunable exchange interactions, and robust thermal stability. However, the simultaneous optimization of these properties remains challenging due to the vast compositional, structural, and interfacial design space governing magnetic systems.
